cards.example_en: Wrong input from the keyboard ruined the saved document.
cards.example_zh: 键盘输入错误，毁掉了已经保存的文档。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：伊斯兰教
cards.example_en: Families at the mosque practise Islam in their daily lives.
cards.example_zh: 清真寺的那些家庭在日常生活中信仰伊斯兰教。

cards.example_en: Cherry trees were in bloom when we landed in Japan.
cards.example_zh: 我们降落在日本时，樱花正在开放。

cards.example_en: Draw a straight line under the title of your essay.
cards.example_zh: 在作文标题下面画一条直线。

cards.example_en: They repaid the loan early after selling the old flat.
cards.example_zh: 卖掉旧公寓以后，他们提前还清了贷款。

cards.example_en: She introduced her mate to her parents over Sunday lunch.
cards.example_zh: 星期天午饭时，她把配偶介绍给了父母。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：高速公路
cards.example_en: Traffic on the motorway was slow because of the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 因为大雨，高速公路上的车开得很慢。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：巴勒斯坦的
cards.example_en: The Palestinian flag uses black, white, green, and red.
cards.example_zh: 巴勒斯坦国旗使用黑、白、绿、红四种颜色。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：可能性
cards.example_en: Snow on Friday night is a real possibility.
cards.example_zh: 周五夜里确实有下雪的可能性。

cards.example_en: Heavy rain soaked our school bags on the way home.
cards.example_zh: 回家路上，大雨把我们的书包淋湿了。

cards.example_en: Every resident on our street recycled glass last month.
cards.example_zh: 上个月，我们这条街上的每位居民都回收了玻璃。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：零售的
cards.example_en: Retail prices at the mall are higher than at the market.
cards.example_zh: 商场里的零售价比菜市场更高。

cards.example_en: Autumn is my favourite season because leaves turn red.
cards.example_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节，因为树叶会变红。

cards.example_en: Security at the airport checked every bag carefully.
cards.example_zh: 机场的安保人员仔细检查了每一个包。

cards.example_en: Deep snow blocked the lane that leads to school.
cards.example_zh: 厚厚的雪堵住了通向学校的小路。
